name: scan-intent-clear-and-extra-write-window
body: The intent is cleared only on the post-record success path - an errored scan (pipeline or layers-ingest failure) leaves it to INTENT_GRACE_SECS (15 min), so a read/reuse phase longer than that window is unprotected; and the intent write opens one extra write transaction (re-taking facts.lock) at the start of every non-fast-path scan, so store contention now fails the scan before prepare/frontends rather than after the frontend work (deliberate fail-fast, matching the probe and the phase-3 record boundary). Upgrade to a drop-guard when the read/reuse phase could exceed the grace window, or fold the intent write into an existing write transaction if the extra lock acquisition becomes a measured cost.
